description: Fresh bilingual input cases for independent Codex-agent relay. No model outputs or expected answers are stored in this file. Each case starts in a separate fresh room at the baseline below. All proposals are concurrent full-segment replacements authored before any proposal is reviewed.

segments.en: The Community Makers Evening is on 7 November 2026, from 16:00 to 20:00 local time.
segments.es: La Tarde Comunitaria de Creadores se celebra el 7 de noviembre de 2026, de 16:00 a 20:00, hora local.

segments.en: Children under 10 enter free. Everyone aged 10 or older needs a ticket.
segments.es: La entrada es gratuita para menores de 10 años. Quienes tengan 10 años o más necesitan entrada.

segments.en: Meet in the library courtyard at 18 Oak Street. Step-free access is available through the south entrance.
segments.es: Nos reunimos en el patio de la biblioteca de la calle Oak, número 18. La entrada sur dispone de acceso sin escalones.

segments.en: Workshop participants must be at least 16 years old and live in the neighborhood.
segments.es: Para participar en el taller, hay que tener al menos 16 años y residir en el barrio.

segments.en: Registration closes on 5 November 2026 at 18:00 local time.
segments.es: La inscripción cierra el 5 de noviembre de 2026 a las 18:00, hora local.

segments.en: Tickets are refundable when a cancellation is received at least 24 hours before the event starts.
segments.es: Las entradas son reembolsables si la cancelación se recibe al menos 24 horas antes del inicio del evento.
